name: molecule-desci
description: DeSci molecule orchestration for Molecule Labs in one skill (aura-orchestrator): POI registration + IP-NFT minting + project creation + x402-paid data-room file upload (public or client-side-encrypted) + announcement + transfer, backed by the custody-free `molecule` MCP server.
